svg.title: What I do
svg.desc: IT infrastructure engineer with seven years of experience in systems administration, cloud infrastructure, automation, and security.
svg.text: IT Infrastructure Engineer with 7 years of experience bridging traditional system
administration and cloud native approaches. I manage 500+ endpoints across Azure and
AWS, with a strong foundation in Windows and Linux server administration, enterprise
networking, and GDPR-aligned Zero Trust security.
I build infrastructure that runs quietly in the background, scales without drama, stays
secure, and rarely needs anyone to step in. If your systems feel messy, manual, or held
together by too many late-night fixes, that is the kind of problem I like solving.
Bring me the chaos, I will hand back something clean and self-reliant. Reach out anytime,
